sentences.text: The valley is quiet before the storm.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: در این دره خانه‌ای قدیمی هست.
sentences.speaker: lina

sentences.text: We waited for the rain to come.
sentences.speaker: omid

sentences.text: I can hear it on the roof!
sentences.speaker: sara

sentences.text: And then the river was full again.
sentences.speaker: narrator
